changelog: Initial release: PPTX→PDF conversion, 3 watermark layouts (diagonal/grid/center), cross-platform font auto-detection, web UI for parameter tuning
summary: Convert PPT/PPTX to PDF and add customizable watermarks. Supports diagonal/grid/center layouts, adjustable font size, opacity, rotation, and color. Trigger words: 加水印、转PDF、PDF水印、导出PDF、水印工具、add watermark、convert to PDF、PDF watermark. Includes a mobile-friendly web UI for real-time parameter tuning.
